name: Workflow 3 – Création et publication de contenu

parameters.query:
SELECT topic, target_audience, tone, keywords, platform
FROM content_calendar
WHERE scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE
  AND status = 'planned'
ORDER BY priority DESC
LIMIT 1;

=INSERT INTO content_posts (topic, platform, content, status, scheduled_date, created_at)
VALUES
  ('{{ $json.topic }}', 'linkedin', '{{ $json.linkedinPost.replace("'", "''") }}', 'pending_review', CURRENT_DATE, NOW()),
  ('{{ $json.topic }}', 'instagram', '{{ $json.instagramPost.replace("'", "''") }}', 'pending_review', CURRENT_DATE, NOW())
RETURNING id, platform, content;

=SELECT id, platform, content FROM content_posts
WHERE scheduled_date = CURRENT_DATE
  AND status = 'approved'
  AND published_at IS NULL;

=UPDATE content_posts SET published_at = NOW(), status = 'published'
WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};
